question: Should Control UI add a dedicated expanded composer modal for long prompts, or should the inline autogrow, modifier-send shortcut, and large-paste attachment paths remain the intended solution?
rationale: The request is useful and aligned with web frontend ergonomics, but it adds a second composer mode whose draft ownership, attachment, queue, focus, and send semantics are product choices rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
options.body: Build the modal editor as a bounded Control UI feature with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and inline-versus-modal keyboard tests.

options.title: Prefer Inline Composer
options.body: Treat the current inline composer improvements and shortcut preference as the intended long-prompt path and close or narrow the modal request.

options.title: Defer Mode Choice
options.body: Keep the issue open but outside repair automation until a Control UI owner chooses the editor shape.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
recommendation.body: Build the modal editor as a bounded Control UI feature with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and inline-versus-modal keyboard tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest adjacent send-shortcut ownership and prior review context for this issue.
